purpose: Digest-pinned identification of the Rust crates compiled for the librsvg-c static library inside the redistributed @img/sharp-libvips-darwin-arm64 1.3.2 combined binary: a resolver approximation from the retained librsvg 2.62.90 Cargo.lock and recipe edits, cross-checked against the retained historical job log so that observed compilation is bound per crate, for acquisition into an ignored build directory by scripts/prepare-libvips-source-materials.mjs. Observed compilation is distinct from incorporation into the shipped binary; this is explicitly partial, not a corresponding-source offer, and not legal clearance.

npmProvenanceAttestation.statement: Binds the shipped npm tarball bytes to one GitHub Actions run of the pinned commit. It does not enumerate compiled crates.

workflowJob.logStatus: retrieved-and-retained: the complete job log (all steps, 08:52:28Z–09:16:58Z) was downloaded on 2026-09-05T23:53:59Z by the Codex review lane with normally configured GitHub CLI authentication (GET only, no new scopes) and retained as owner-private evidence; see historicalBuildEvidence.jobLog and observedCompilation.

cargoInvocation.featureNotes: cargo_wrapper.py adds 'avif' only when libdav1d is found and 'pixbuf' only when gdk-pixbuf is found; the recipe builds neither (-Dpixbuf{,-loader}=disabled; dav1d is not built), so librsvg-c is built with no explicit features.
cargoInvocation.target: aarch64-apple-darwin (host target; the recipe sets -Dtriplet only when RUST_TARGET is defined, which it is not for darwin-arm64v8)
cargoInvocation.toolchain: rustup nightly installed at build time; observed as rustc 1.98.0-nightly (096694416 2026-06-29) with cargo-c 0.10.23+cargo-0.97.1 (see toolchainObserved)

recipeEdits.edit: cargo update --workspace: per Cargo's documented semantics this re-resolves only workspace members and leaves every existing non-workspace lock entry at its locked version; packages no longer required are pruned, packages not already present would be added (none are introduced by removing features)

jobLog.retrievedBy: Codex review lane, normally configured GitHub CLI authentication, GET only; no alternate credentials, scope changes or upstream code execution
jobLog.sanitization: local filter removing the UTF-8 BOM, ANSI OSC/CSI sequences, carriage returns and C0 controls other than tab/newline; line numbering preserved
jobLog.retention: owner-private ignored build evidence directory claude-rust-handback-review-2026-09-06 of the coordination checkout, sealed by SHA256SUMS (manifest sha256 74c16427f8f9a5fd56b90855142b4f79c28ca9352fa31ecbdb9270603c9a1fb4); the log is not committed to source
jobLog.truncationOrCacheMarkers: none found for: truncated|truncating|log limit|maximum log|logs have been|output omitted|Cache restored|cache hit|actions/cache|Fresh; absence of markers is not proof that silent reuse was impossible

lockfileListed.detail: Every [[package]] entry of the retained Cargo.lock, including dev-only and platform-specific packages.

reachableFromBuiltMember.detail: Transitive closure of Cargo.lock 'dependencies' from librsvg-c, ignoring targets and features; the lockfile graph is target- and feature-agnostic.

workspaceMembers: librsvg 2.63.0-beta.0 (rsvg/Cargo.toml package version inside the retained librsvg-2.62.90 archive)
resolvedForTargetApproximation.detail: Computed on 05/09/2026 by a simplified resolver over the exact Cargo.toml of every reached crate (read from its checksum-verified .crate file) with the recipe's feature edits applied: cfg(...) dependency tables evaluated for aarch64-apple-darwin, optional dependencies enabled only through activated features, dev-dependencies excluded, build-dependencies and proc-macro crates classified separately. Unknown cfg predicates were treated as true (superset direction). This is not Cargo's resolver and not the historical build log. Cross-checked on 2026-09-06 against the retained job log: 157 of the 159 registry crates were observed compiling in the librsvg phase; rustc_version 0.4.1 and semver 1.0.28 were not.

compiledInHistoricalBuild.detail: Observed compile events in the retained job log of run 28432216836 job 84249528353 (raw sha256 b7b3362b…): 157 registry crates plus the two workspace packages. Bound per item as provenanceStatus compiled-per-build-log with log line and timestamp. Observed compilation is not a resolved feature graph, does not authenticate every source byte independently of the checksummed archives, and does not establish incorporation into the shipped dylib.

incorporatedIntoShippedBinary.detail: librsvg-c is built with fat LTO, codegen-units=1, opt-level=z and linked with -Wl,-dead_strip; proc-macro and build-only crates are never linked, and any normal crate may be wholly or partly eliminated. The retained compile log is not a linkage map; no binary inspection was performed and strings alone would not prove inclusion.

unretained.detail: The retained job log supplies observed 'Compiling' events for the librsvg phase (157 registry crates and two workspace packages). No explicit truncation, cache-hit or 'Fresh' markers were found, but that does not prove that silent reuse or unlogged activity was impossible, and the log does not enumerate the resolved feature graph.

The simplified resolver's 159-crate set was cross-checked against the observed compile events: every observed registry crate is in the set, and two set members (rustc_version 0.4.1, semver 1.0.28) were not observed. Those two stay resolved-approximation; they are not removed, and no exclusion from every intermediate artifact is asserted. The resolver still does not model Cargo's feature unification exactly.
Fat LTO and dead-stripping mean the set of crates whose code survives in libvips-cpp.8.18.3.dylib is a subset of the compiled set and is not established here.

Six crates (block 0.1.6, malloc_buf 0.0.6, mutants 0.0.4, objc-foundation 0.1.1, objc_id 0.1.1, selectors 0.38.0) carry no licence text member in their .crate archive (noticeStatus no-licence-text-in-crate). Config/SharpLibvipsRustNoticeMaterials.json records the version-bound upstream investigation for each: mutants and selectors have exact external notice material retained under Resources/ThirdPartyLicenses/sharp-libvips-1.3.2/rust/ (labelled external; never archive members), while the four Steven Sheldon crates remain unresolved because neither their archives nor their tagged upstream revisions publish any licence text or copyright statement.
librsvg and librsvg-c (LGPL-2.1-or-later) are covered by the librsvg archive and its COPYING.LIB notice in Config/ThirdPartyBinaryProvenance.json; they are not registry crates and are not items here.

MPL-2.0 crates carry a source-availability obligation for their own files, and Unicode-3.0 crates carry notice requirements; the .crate files pinned here are the exact source of those crates, but how they are made available is an owner/legal decision, not established by this manifest.
